text: The sponsor Raize is the Portuguese payment institution Raize - Instituição de Pagamentos, S.A. (listed in 2018 as Raize Serviços de Gestão, S.A.): Euronext welcomed Raize on its listing in Euronext Access in Lisbon on 18 July 2018, under ticker MLRZE.
short: Raize is the Lisbon-listed payment institution (MLRZE).

source.name: Euronext press release: Raize lists on Euronext
source.quote: Euronext today welcomed Raize Serviços de Gestão (Raize) on its listing in Euronext Access in Lisbon.
source.note: The company was later renamed Raize - Instituição de Pagamentos, S.A.; the club's partners page (https://gilvicentefc.pt/patrocinadores/) links the Raize shirt mark to raize.pt, the company's platform.

additionalSources.name: Jornal Económico: Flexdeal quer aumentar participação na Raize para 51%
additionalSources.quote: As ações representativas do capital social da Raize encontra-se admitidas à negociação no Mercado Regulamentado gerido pela Euronext Lisbon.
additionalSources.note: English: the shares representing the share capital of Raize are admitted to trading on the regulated market run by Euronext Lisbon. The same report names the company Raize - Instituição de Pagamentos.
